svg.title: m2_encapsulation_v1: plan view
svg.text: Module 2: encapsulation (REFERENCE ONLY, 30 x 20 mm; droplet generation NOT achievable)
chip/m2_encapsulation_v1.json · footprint 30 × 20 mm · plan view, to scale · all dimensions mm
Every chamber and channel is 0.3 mm deep: one embossing depth, a resin-printed tool hot-embossed into the layer, with the tubing ports drilled through the lid.
Small grey names are the contracts/blocks.json CAD block each chamber and channel is built from; red means it is not in the library.
Tightest clearance between unconnected features: 0.60 mm, between port 'm2_core_in_1' and chamber 'm2_filter_core_1'. Planar check: no overlaps.
